items.prompt: A stone underground corridor under an old house: a low vaulted ceiling, floor of old wooden boards worn smooth, a single bulb far ahead; two men walk away from us toward a closed door at the end.

alt.ru: Каменный подземный коридор под старым домом: низкий свод, пол из старых отполированных досок, далеко впереди одна лампочка; двое уходят к закрытой двери в конце.
alt.en: A stone corridor beneath an old house: a low vault, a floor of old boards worn smooth, a single bulb far ahead; two men walking toward a closed door at the end.
alt.pt: Um corredor de pedra sob uma casa antiga: abóbada baixa, soalho de tábuas velhas polidas, uma lâmpada lá ao fundo; dois homens a caminhar para uma porta fechada.
alt.es: Un pasillo de piedra bajo una casa antigua: bóveda baja, suelo de tablas viejas pulidas, una bombilla al fondo; dos hombres caminando hacia una puerta cerrada.

items.prompt: A square bare room with stone walls: two candles burn on the floor in the corners, the middle of the room empty, and two wooden chairs stand by the wall angled toward each other; one is occupied by a man in shadow.

alt.ru: Квадратная голая комната с каменными стенами: в углах на полу горят две свечи, середина пуста, у стены под углом друг к другу два деревянных стула, на одном человек в тени.
alt.en: A bare square stone room: two candles on the floor in the corners, the middle empty, two wooden chairs by the wall angled toward each other, a man in shadow on one.
alt.pt: Uma sala quadrada de pedra vazia: duas velas no chão nos cantos, o centro vazio, duas cadeiras de madeira junto à parede viradas uma para a outra, um homem na sombra numa delas.
alt.es: Una sala cuadrada de piedra vacía: dos velas en el suelo en las esquinas, el centro vacío, dos sillas de madera junto a la pared en ángulo, un hombre en sombra en una.
